content:
See the content developed for this project!

BUILT CoLAB established a protocol with the APA – Portuguese Environment Agency and the Fundo Ambiental with the aim of promoting a set of actions under the “Soil Quality Assessment” project.

These actions focus mainly on the topic of Contaminated Soils and Rocks, aiming to raise awareness among various stakeholders –  from private sector companies to public entities in the environmental field – of soil quality assessment processes and their risk analysis and sustainable remediation, thereby contributing to the prevention of and fight against soil pollution.

Training Cycle

It is in this context that BUILT CoLAB is organising three Training Courses aimed at stakeholders involved with contaminated soils and rocks, in order to  provide various content on soil assessment operations and techniques for remediating contaminated soil.


3 October

Designers, Project Owners and Regulators: Challenges and Solutions

3pm – 4:30pm – Digital, via Teams – Event Ended

This session on contaminated soils and rocks, dedicated to the perspective of designers, project owners and regulators, will cover concepts, the existing legal framework, soil assessment and remediation methods, and the opportunities and good practices that should be implemented. Case studies will also be presented, for a deeper understanding of the topic.

Speakers:
Marco Rocha –  Brownfield
Sérgio Moreira – Gaiurb
Sandra Silva – APA
Leonor Santos – BUILT CoLAB

Session Video
Presentations


17 October

Construction and Demolition Companies: Challenges and Solutions

3pm – 4:30pm – Digital, via Teams – Event Ended

This session on contaminated soils and rocks, dedicated to the perspective of construction and demolition companies, will cover concepts, the existing legal framework, soil assessment and remediation methods, ways of preventing soil contamination during the construction and demolition of buildings, and the opportunities and good practices that should be implemented. Case studies will also be presented, for a deeper understanding of the topic.

Speakers:
Rui Barros Garcia – Garcia Garcia
Ricardo Manuel Leite Pinto – Grupo Casais
Móniva Cabaça – APA
Leonor Santos – BUILT CoLAB

Session Video
Presentations


31 October

Soil Remediation Entities​ - Challenges and Solutions

3pm – 4:30pm – Digital, via Teams – Event Ended

This session on contaminated soils and rocks, dedicated to the perspective of management entities and soil remediation companies, will cover concepts, the existing legal framework, innovative soil assessment and remediation techniques and examples, and the opportunities and good practices that should be implemented. Case studies on soil and C&DW treatment systems and the recovery of recycled aggregate will also be examined, for a deeper understanding of the topic.

Speakers:
António Roque – LNEC
Florence Bouche – Valgo
Carla Rodrigues – APA
Leonor Santos – BUILT COLAB
